purpose: Human-readable reconstruction checklist, not a fabricated authenticated REA obligation ledger

required.title: Local video import
required.source: Video document declarations, native AVFoundation imports
acceptance: Read MP4/MOV and display source duration
Report unsupported or missing media without corrupting projects

required.title: Video URL acquisition
required.source: yt-dlp/qjs/ffmpeg bundled; demo source.kind=link
acceptance: Download supported URLs through an explicit subprocess boundary
Report network/site failures and cancellation

required.title: Word-timed transcript
required.source: demo.json absolute source word times; runtime disclosure ElevenLabs Scribe v2
acceptance: Preserve start/end and speaker for each word
Display/copy/export full transcript
Do not confuse source time with rendered clip time

required.title: Chunked transcription fallback
required.source: Native function 0x10033cba4 checks cancellation/error cases and branches to chunked fallback
acceptance: Chunk according to selected provider limits
Retain ordering and restore absolute timestamps
Surface unrecoverable transcription failures

required.title: AI moment selection
required.source: Native prompt builder 0x1002ffc1c; source-bound transcript boundary contract
acceptance: Return bounded start/end, title, score, label, reason
Accept only timestamps tied to transcript boundaries
Favor complete standalone thoughts

required.title: Selection preferences
required.source: Static fields and official feature claims
acceptance: Auto or Manual mode
Count and 15–30, 30–60, 60–90, custom duration choices
Per-run request, input replacement, output folder

required.title: Moment scoring/explanations
required.source: demo rating fields; embedded score/label/reason prompt
acceptance: 0–100 score and concise explanation
Expose ranking to manual review

required.title: Sentence removal recut
required.source: Static instruction Keep at least one sentence; official feature claim
acceptance: Include/exclude sentences and require one retained sentence
Per-sentence speaker assignment and global speaker swap
Re-cut enabled only after edit changes
Maintain a source-to-output time map

required.title: Pause/filler removal
required.source: Root observed settings toggle
acceptance: Optional removal of silence/filler sounds
Recompute timing for captions and framing

required.title: Local speaker segmentation
required.source: Four community-1 CoreML models and static fallback log
acceptance: Speaker intervals run locally where supported
Continue without speaker labels on a recoverable diarization failure

required.title: Speaker-follow portrait framing
required.source: Native face/body/pose/landmark requests and crop functions; runtime disclosure; seats metadata
acceptance: 9:16 composition follows selected/active speaker when association is supported
Preserve useful content when association is uncertain
Allow speaker-label correction in the independent implementation
required.intentional_difference: Edward preserves the full frame instead of reproducing Cloth body/pose/object/hand fallback.

required.title: Word captions and speaker color
required.source: Runtime subtitle and speaker-color toggles; static timing schema
acceptance: Bottom/top/off per-run placement
Optional speaker colors
Word captions follow recut time mapping

required.title: Platform-safe placement
required.source: Native function 0x100371248 and recovered three-platform numeric table
acceptance: Account for top/bottom and asymmetric side controls in a conservative caption safe region
Verify caption bounding box against an exported frame

required.title: Video rendering
required.source: 1080x1920 native composition 0x100387c48 and Core Animation captions 0x10038969c; UI quality choices
acceptance: Expose Standard/Sharp/Maximum quality choices; distinguish acquisition settings from export settings
Render source-time edits with matching captions/framing
Disk-space errors, cancellation, successful output location

required.title: Per-run library
required.source: demo schema; runtime and official feature descriptions
acceptance: Rename, run again, reveal, delete run
Show run title/date/source duration/count
Expand/copy/save transcript text
Copy/open source link

required.title: Output and completion preferences
required.source: Root observed output-folder/Finder/sound controls
acceptance: Choose output directory
Optional Finder reveal and completion sound

required.title: Standing instruction
required.source: Root observed ALWAYS ASK FOR field; standingPrompt literal
acceptance: Persist optional global instruction
Combine with per-run instruction using documented precedence

required.title: Progress/cancel/retry
required.source: JobStage and cancellation metadata; native cancellation handling; observed run controls
acceptance: Visible processing stages
Cancellation stops owned work
Retry preserves completed expensive stages where possible

required.title: Transcript and curation reuse
required.source: CurationMemo.Key fields and native same-transcript/settings reuse branch
acceptance: Cache identity includes source and relevant model/settings
Changing semantic inputs invalidates cached result

required.title: Diagnostic export
required.source: Root observed UI says no keys/links/transcripts
acceptance: Export useful stage/error diagnostics without credentials or media content
Provide reproducible failure descriptions

required.title: Welcome/demo
required.source: Packaged onboarding media and timing JSON, runtime replay control
acceptance: Explain ingest/analyze/review/export flow
New app uses original demonstration assets, not copied Cloth resources

required.title: User-selected model/providers
required.source: User-required intentional difference
acceptance: Direct user API keys and compatible models
No Setapp identity, keys, credits, or server dependency
Capability-gated routing for transcription/text/vision/video

limitations: Paid workflows have not run because the observed Setapp balance is zero.
No implementation is marked passed by this research inventory.
Static literals and imported libraries do not establish runtime reachability.
Implementation integration and test status belong to the root build; this research checklist does not mark source inspection as a passed test.
source_audit_status: Reported integration findings verified resolved in source; execution results remain owned by the root build
